content.short: A community-focused investment club offering insights on trading/investing in crypto, forex, and the US stock market.
content.description:
Alpha Surfers began minting in March 2023. We are an alpha group and an investment club. Our primary goal is to deliver value and rewards to our holders. We do that by offering insights and discussions in CNFT projects, Cardano projects, and trading/investing in crypto, forex, Cardano Native Tokens, upcoming IDO/ICOs, and the US stock market. The motto here is that a rising tide lifts all boats.

The Alpha Surfers NFT serves as a lifetime digital membership to the group, and unlocks holder-only channels. These channels include trading channels, giveaways, future airdrops, project analysis, project announcements, etc.

Our team is strong and with the help of certain sharks will continue to provide as much value as we can. As the treasury grows, our holders wallets also grow. 70& of pre-tax profit goes to holders.
